description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Sai of the Shinobi, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Memnite.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Memnite.
Memnite dies, triggering Koll, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
